meta.title: Rabat CO 26.2
meta.subtitle: Avengers Assemble
meta.tagline: Different powers. Different perspectives. One team. One mission.
meta.themeStory:
AIESEC Rabat has spent the last six months in its own kind of Civil War. Not because we lacked talented people — but because our strengths weren't always connected by one common mission. Just like the Avengers, we learned that powerful individuals don't automatically make a powerful team.

This conference is our Endgame moment: not to erase what happened, but to face it — to rebuild trust, reconnect the team, and develop the next generation of Avengers who won't repeat the mistakes of the last one.

Different powers. Different perspectives. One team. One mission.
Avengers, Assemble.

day1.themeDesc: Facing the fractures, uncovering lost trust, and discovering what it truly means to assemble.
